t: You're at Restaurant Gordon Ramsay, on Royal Hospital Road in Chelsea. It opened in 1998 and was the first solo restaurant of the chef Gordon Ramsay. It is his signature restaurant, and it has held three Michelin stars since 2001. Today it is run by the chef Matt Abé. Ramsay became widely known after the television series Boiling Point in 1999, and his restaurant group, founded in 1997, has won seventeen Michelin stars overall.
